missing_information_behavior: Do not issue a strong multivitamin recommendation from general wellness alone; assess diet, life stage, restrictions and existing use.
safety_exclusions: Do not claim multivitamins prevent chronic disease or replace a balanced diet.
Do not infer deficiencies from a general wellness goal.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy, diagnosed deficiency, malabsorption, chronic disease or medically prescribed supplementation.
population_and_context: Adults selecting general wellness as a goal without a specific documented nutrient gap or clinical indication.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule. If a product is considered, assess formulation against dietary reference values and avoid unnecessary high-dose combinations.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Multivitamin/mineral fact sheet summarizes heterogeneous formulations and limited evidence for many broad health outcomes. This justification remains draft pending source passage verification, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional review.
